integrity: Exact analytic proof with independently executable deterministic rational checker. Historical priority qualified; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform sites on a unit circle, geodesic Voronoi cells, n>=3, cyclically ordered and oriented lengths relative to a uniformly marked site. Even-order density uses intrinsic (n-2)-dimensional coordinates; no ambient density is claimed. Earlier equivalent moving-average Dirichlet results may exist.
title: Parity-rigid inversion and the exact joint law of circular Voronoi cell lengths
